title: Log, alert and incident triage
description: Decide whether a log excerpt, CI failure or alert is real, how severe it is, and which team owns it

text.description: the log excerpt, CI failure or alert payload

open_incident.description: profile dedupe: the open incident and its root cause, put ahead of the alert in the state

profile.description: dedupe also asks whether the alert is a symptom of open_incident (output open_duplicate)

real.instructions: Does this log excerpt or alert show a real failure that needs a human, as opposed to routine noise?

criteria.true: a real failure or risk that someone must look at
criteria.false: routine, expected or self-healed noise; nobody needs to act

sev.instructions: How severe is the problem shown in this log or alert?
criteria: real problem, needs a human this week
service degraded or broken for users, needs a human now
outage or data loss, page immediately

criteria: real problem, needs a human this week

outage or data loss, page immediately

dup.instructions: Is the new alert a symptom of the already open incident, rather than a separate new problem?

criteria.true: same root cause as the open incident; attach it, do not open a new one
criteria.false: an unrelated problem that needs its own incident

combine: page if real >= page_real and sev >= page_sev; suppress if real < suppress_real and sev < suppress_sev; watch if real < watch_real; watch if sev >= suppress_sev and sev < review_sev; review otherwise

open_duplicate.combine: yes if dup >= dup_yes; no otherwise

limitations: severity reflects the text, not business context
collapse long logs into clusters (a filter job, one noul per cluster)
a SOC study found a linear SVM beat LLM prioritisation: deterministic rules stay ahead for known-critical alerts and verified secrets, the read refines
never execute remediation from a log
the subsystem and CODEOWNERS routing choices are not built
a day of alerts is a batch job over real and sev
notes: # deviation: spec 5.13: the dedupe noul is the profile `dedupe` with the open incident in state (output open_duplicate); the subsystem and owner routing questions are not built; 'choice p_top below 0.6 gives review' has no choice question to apply to
